Container.Name: Unifi to Discord webhook
Container.Overview:
This is a tiny webhook listener that listens for Unifi's webhooks sent to the docker container's IP:PORT and formats the message to a Discord webhook.
You can add devices by using a device's mac address as a variable and the device name as the variable name, visit the project's repo for a read me.

Config.Name: WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Port for the setup page. Change this to reach the page on a different port; the WebUI link follows it.
